- [G1] The deliverable is a strategic recommendation report on reducing employee turnover rates | src: "Write a strategic recommendation report on reducing employee turnover rates"
  - [G1.1] The report presents actionable recommendations for employee retention rather than only describing turnover | src: G1
- [G2] The report is aimed at middle and senior management levels | src: "Aimed at middle and senior management levels."
- [G3] The report uses a formal and professional yet accessible writing style and avoids overly academic language | src: "The writing style should be formal and professional yet accessible, avoiding overly academic language."
- [G4] The report has a clear structure suitable for leadership meetings or presentations at HR forums | src: "The report should have a clear structure, suitable for leadership meetings or presentations at HR forums."
- [G5] The report is between 3,000 and 3,500 words | src: "Word count should be between 3,000 and 3,500 words."
- [G6] The report is logically rigorous and comprehensive | src: "Please ensure the report is logically rigorous, comprehensive, and ready for internal discussions or external presentations."
- [G7] The report is ready for internal discussions or external presentations | src: "Please ensure the report is logically rigorous, comprehensive, and ready for internal discussions or external presentations."
- [G8] The report incorporates the supplied best practices for employee retention strategies from industry benchmark companies | src: "Best practices for employee retention strategies from industry benchmark companies can reference: Overall Strategy"
  - [G8.1] The report recommends clarifying retention objectives and strategies after identifying core employees to retain, using effective surveys and combining measures into a strategic plan | src: "After identifying core employees to retain, conduct effective surveys to provide quality information for retention plan design, which can then be transformed into practical core employee retention goals. Based on these goals, combine multiple measures to form a strategic plan for core employee retention."
  - [G8.2] The report recommends building an employer brand that satisfies employees and creates belonging, value, and respect | src: "an excellent employer brand will make core employees less likely to be poached by high salaries and help organizations form unique competitive advantages"
  - [G8.3] The report recommends an early warning mechanism using integrated internal and external HR information to identify and prevent core employee turnover risks | src: "The establishment of an early warning mechanism allows preventive control measures to be taken before risks appear or show early signs"
  - [G8.4] The report addresses recruiting with retention in mind by reviewing job quality, defining competency-based requirements, and considering development potential and professional adaptability | src: "Make thorough recruitment preparations by reviewing whether the position is a \"good job\" and redefining requirements based on competencies."
- [G9] The report begins with a one-page executive summary that lists the three highest-priority recommendations and gives each recommendation an owner and a 90-day first milestone | src: "Please add a one-page executive summary at the start that lists the three highest-priority recommendations, and give each recommendation an owner and a 90-day first milestone."
  - [G9.1] The executive summary is one page and appears at the start of the report | src: G9
  - [G9.2] The executive summary lists exactly three highest-priority recommendations | src: G9
  - [G9.3] Each of the three recommendations names an owner and a first milestone due within 90 days | src: G9
